subject.title: [Feature]: When messages are merged and processed, the agent event is expected to carry the original runId(s)

question: What public Gateway event contract should represent source-run lineage when multiple `chat.send` requests merge into one executed agent run?
rationale: The source path is clear, but automation should not choose stable protocol field names, ordering semantics, duplicate handling, or whether `runId` remains the execution identity.

options.title: Add lineage array
options.body: Keep `runId` as the executed run ID and add an ordered `sourceRunIds`/`originalRunIds` style field to public agent/chat events for merged work.

options.title: Reuse one source ID
options.body: Use the first or last queued source ID as the public merged run ID, which helps simple clients but loses full lineage.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Leave clients to correlate through accepted responses, history, and session state, accepting that live merged events have no source-run lineage.

recommendation.title: Add lineage array
recommendation.body: Keep `runId` as the executed run ID and add an ordered `sourceRunIds`/`originalRunIds` style field to public agent/chat events for merged work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history and timeline signal for Gateway event and queue semantics.
